messages:
morgan: heads up — console alerted on a big token spike for acct 3889 around 10:22 UTC, looks tied to streaming requests that hit a cross-region fallback. link: https://console.redwood/test/alerts/3889 :eyes:

alex: can you paste router logs? curious if it’s a retry vs duplicate accounting

morgan: pasted snippets below

morgan: ```
router.INFO 2026-03-12T10:21:58Z req_id=zx3k client_session=cs-42 route=eu-west1 -> start stream
router.INFO 2026-03-12T10:22:10Z req_id=zx3k client_session=cs-42 route=eu-west1 -> connection aborted (EOF)
router.INFO 2026-03-12T10:22:11Z req_id=zx3k-handback client_session=cs-42 route=us-east1 -> resumed stream, toolcall id=tc-99
router.INFO 2026-03-12T10:22:12Z billing.INFO session=cs-42 provisional_tokens=320 confirmed_tokens=0
router.INFO 2026-03-12T10:22:13Z billing.INFO session=cs-42 provisional_tokens=320 confirmed_tokens=320
```

morgan: i.e. provisional tokens were credited when eu-west1 started the stream, then after failover us-east1 re-credited tokens on resume -> double count in dashboard spikes

sasha: are toolcalls implicated (we saw duplicate external tool usage in similar cases before)?

alex: do we have a unique global request id across handoffs? req_id looks different (`zx3k` vs `zx3k-handback`)

luke: yep that's the gap — handoff creates a new req id and billing treats it as distinct session because we only dedupe on req_id. session id is same but we only look at req_id when deciding provisional=dedupe

morgan: i can repro in staging — streaming abort -> reconnect via fallback path -> we emit a new `request_id` and both sides mark provisional until final ack, so UI shows two provisional buckets then one confirmed, but ledger ends up double-counting unless reconcile job trims duplicates

sasha: how often do we reconcile? nightly? that's not good for real-time dashboards or alerts

morgan: nightly -> too late for spikes/alerting

alex: short-term mitigation idea: emit a `handoff_parent_id` header on the resumed request referencing original req_id and have billing service dedupe provisional tokens if parent_id matches and session_id matches

luke: alternative: change router to preserve the request_id across region handoffs (simpler), but that might be risky for tracing/observability semantics

morgan: preserving req_id seems safest for billing but we need to ensure traces show the handoff clearly (maybe add `handoff=true` attribute rather than changing id semantics)

sasha: console UX: we should annotate chart with failover events so pagers know spikes may be transient and auto-suppress alerts for confirmed vs provisional mismatch

alex: agree — and add metric: provisional_vs_confirmed_ratio per route, to detect when provisional accrual doesn't resolve within Xs

morgan: quick patch I'm going to try: billing service will ignore provisional credits if it sees an active provisional record with same session_id and same model+prompt_hash in the last 2m; will also log a dedupe event for ops

luke: be careful — could mask legitimate rapid-resume scenarios where tokens legitimately accrue on resumed segments. we need unit tests against streaming segmentation

morgan: yep adding tests. also flagging toolcall flows: toolcalls currently confirm at tool response; if toolcall happens on fallback we may double-invoke external services. need a guard to dedupe toolcall invocation by call_id.

sasha: can we add a `toolcall_idempotency_key` in the router that survives handoffs? if yes, tool infra can dedupe invocations

alex: ops ask: do we need an emergency rollback or quick UI filter to hide the spike? customers are pinging support

morgan: short term: hide provisional tokens on the billing dashboard by default and add a toggle for "include provisional" (ops can turn on for debugging). I'll push a console patch to reduce customer confusion

billing-bot: [auto] Created billing incident INC-2026-188 for duplicated provisional credits; owner=morgan; severity=low -> med until we confirm damage

luke: next steps: (1) prod-safe router change to preserve req_id or attach parent_id (decide), (2) billing dedupe rule + tests, (3) toolcall idempotency keys, (4) console UX toggle + provisional_vs_confirmed metric + alert tuning

sasha: can someone draft a short RFC for the router semantics change? want to avoid breaking tracing expectations

morgan: i'll draft RFC and link in thread: https://go/redwood/rfc/handoff-reqid-2026

alex: thanks — tagging @oncall for visibility. :thumbsup:

morgan: assigning follow-ups: morgan->billing dedupe PR, luke->router prototype, sasha->toolcall idempotency proposal, alex->console toggle PR

luke: will sync with observability team about how to annotate traces when req_id preserved

morgan: will post revert plan if any customer refunds required, for now monitoring and hiding provisional on UI

alex: thanks all — good triage. :white_check_mark:
